Perform required electrical calculations including current capacity, cable sizing, voltage drop, losses and protection sizing. Support integration and troubleshooting of BMS communications including CAN, RS485 and Modbus, as applicable. Participate in the development, modification and validation of new battery products, capacities, configurations and future product generations. Provide practical technical assessment, diagnosis and troubleshooting of battery/electrical systems when required, including on-site or field support. 2. Maintain disciplined revision control and engineering documentation for approved products and changes. Work with Mechanical Engineering and Production to translate approved designs into safe and repeatable assembly and testing processes. Define electrical assembly requirements, connections, protection requirements, torque requirements and acceptance criteria. Support Engineering Change Control and technical evaluation of component substitutions or product modifications. 3. Testing, Validation & R&D Define and supervise electrical testing and validation of cells, BMSs, battery packs and finished products. Support the selection and proper use of battery cyclers, BMS testers, cell testing/sorting equipment, insulation/HiPot testers and related engineering equipment. Participate in and supervise assigned R&D projects, prototypes and technical investigations, ensuring proper testing, documentation and technical conclusions. Support product development and testing in accordance with applicable IEC 62619, UN 38.3, ISO and HESS quality requirements. 4. Engineering Leadership & Cross-Functional Support Provide technical guidance, supervision and mentoring to junior engineers and support the coordination of engineering activities across electrical, mechanical and R&D workstreams. Train engineering and production personnel where required on battery systems, electrical assembly, testing, documentation and troubleshooting. Act as an engineering link between the production floor and Engineering/R&D, supporting technical issues, deviations and production improvements. Provide technical support to Business Development, Procurement and Supply Chain when engineering assessment of customer requirements, suppliers, components or technical proposals is required. Participate in site surveys, field assessments, troubleshooting and technical customer/project support when necessary. Strong practical experience with BMSs, electrical protection, schematics, testing and troubleshooting. Demonstrated ability to prepare and control professional engineering documentation. Hands-on mentality and willingness to support prototypes, production, testing and field activities when required. Strong technical leadership, communication and cross-functional coordination capabilities. Previous experience mentoring or supervising engineers is preferred. The role works closely with Mechanical Engineering, Production, QA/QC, Procurement, Supply Chain and Business Development while maintaining clear engineering ownership of product specifications, electrical architecture and technical documentation. Changes affecting approved product designs, safety requirements, certified configurations or key electrical specifications must follow HESS's formal engineering and management approval process.
